answer: Give every agent a TPM-bound identity card. The agent generates its signing key inside a TPM chip and posts its attestation quote. The network verifies the quote and issues one non-transferable card per chip serial. A second registration from the same chip is refused; a lost chip needs a 30-day revocation. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake agents must buy 1,000 TPM chips at $25 each, $25,000 in hardware, and wait two weeks for delivery. Like climbers on one summit rope, the pulse stays honest only when each climber ties in once, and the horizon stays free of duplicate faces.
